title: Singular demonstratives: tämä, tuo, se
focus: Recognise and produce the three singular demonstrative forms.

exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “This is a book.” At a study desk. Use kirja (“a book”) and on (“is”). The identity-sentence frame is supplied; recall only the written demonstrative form. Finnish frame: “___ on kirja.”
exercises.explanation: Tämä is the singular demonstrative for a situation where the referent is close to the speaker.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: demonstrative subject: identifies the referent + linking verb + identity information

Correct. Tämä is the singular demonstrative for a situation where the referent is close to the speaker.
“Tuo” is a singular nominative form for a farther, jointly visible referent; use “Tämä”, a singular nominative form for a referent near the speaker.
“Se” is a singular nominative form for an already identifiable non-human referent; use “Tämä”, a singular nominative form for a referent near the speaker.
